asset.label: Interior Health — Symbol, 2024 strategic direction
asset.dateNote: The document's date, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: The figure, head and swoosh on their own, in the blue the PDF gives them.
asset.fidelityNote: The PDF's own three paths and colour, extracted with PyMuPDF (research/identity/health-bodies-vector-2026-11-16/scripts/interior_health.py); no tracing or redrawing. The PDF's blue converts to #005ba2, brighter than the website JPG's #2f5088; IH's 2024 wayfinding guideline lists Pantone 653 C as both hex 005AA2 and RGB 47/79/136.

asset.label: Interior Health — Stacked (vector reconstruction)

asset.dateNote: The JPG is undated; the parts' PDF was created 26 March 2024. Neither is an adoption date.
asset.notes: The symbol over “Interior Health”, in IH Blue.
asset.fidelityNote: A reconstruction of the stacked layout, not original stacked artwork: no stacked vector was found. Filled #2f4f88, IH Blue as RGB 47/79/136 in IH's wayfinding guideline, which is also the JPG's colour.

asset.label: BC Women's Hospital + Health Centre — Logo, 2024 foundation impact report
asset.publisher: BC Women's Health Foundation (report); logo of BC Women's Hospital + Health Centre
asset.sourceFile: BC Women's Health Foundation Impact Report 2024 (single pages)
asset.dateNote: The report's date, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: The name in teal and grey beside the folded-ribbon W in grey and teal gradients.
asset.fidelityNote: The lettering (30 glyph outlines) and the W's 11 clipping shapes are the PDF's own paths and colours (scripts/bc_womens.py). The PDF fills those shapes with about 800 thin strips, a gradient broken into bands, and paints the three folds with small (34 × 43 px) images that vary only from top to bottom; here each shape is filled with an SVG linear gradient through those strips' or image rows' own colours, at their own heights. No tracing.

asset.label: Mountain and wave emblem (vector reconstruction)
asset.publisher: Central Vancouver Island Health Region; reproduced in The World Without Linen Bags
asset.sourceLocator: PDF page 85 (1-based), the grayscale emblem on a page dated May 1, 1999
asset.dateNote: The date on the source page, a sighting, not an adoption date.
asset.notes: Four peaks, the front one lighter, standing in a wave with two streamers at each end, in greys.
asset.fidelityNote: A hand-fitted reconstruction of the 232 × 112 px grayscale emblem, not original artwork. The four peaks are triangles with 45-degree sides (every apex and edge on the scan fits that slope), cut off along the wave's top edge; the wave is one path through hand-picked points, smoothed as Catmull-Rom curves. No bitmap tracing. The greys (#383838–#5b5b5b) are averages measured on a halftoned photocopy; the original colours are not known. The PDF's vector letterhead (page 58) has only a solid black outline of this emblem, so it could not supply the peaks.
